script_text: Pisces, the cosmic veil tears this month as your watery spirit faces a rare money storm. The dominant transit is Saturn retrograde in Aries in your 2nd house of money, forcing budget discipline and asset defense. Your ruling planet Neptune in Aries muddies shared versus solitary funds, a strange clash for a Water sign. Venus in Leo lights your 6th house of routine, igniting romance through work or gym encounters. Single Pisces may meet a charismatic coworker, while couples deepen bonds via shared schedules. Jupiter in Leo trines your 10th house cusp from the 6th, delivering a promotion or creative honor. Saturn's 2nd-house pressure stabilizes income if you reject risky bets. Mars in Pisces in your 1st house grants intuitive vitality yet saps physical stamina by midmonth. Mark July 22 as Sun enters Leo to energize your 6th house, and July 28 lunar eclipse in Aquarius rattles your 12th house of secrets. Avoid co-signing loans while Saturn retrogrades in your 2nd house. Comment your sign and share with a Pisces friend to ride the tides.
